scope: Next six shortest genuinely under-detailed canonical mechanics records after excluding Batches 396–399

records.name: Super Gamma Blast
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ158. Gamma 1 fires a straight beam from the blaster; holding the input charges the shot, increasing beam size and damage. Current PQ evidence retains the 50% Ultimate-Finish bonus-slot acquisition boundary.

records.name: Reverse Shot
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ123. Fires four Ki bullets; a missed blast can reverse after about one second and track the opponent from behind. At red health, the attack uses eight blasts. Current references report 5% total damage for the normal four-blast version and 15% for the red-health version; exact frame/hitbox data remains unresolved.

records.name: Super Ghost Buu Attack
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ113 Basic Reward. Creates five Buu-shaped ghosts in front of the user; a second input launches them, while leaving them in place for about five seconds also sends them toward the opponent. Current reference reports 5% total damage across five hits; no narrower CaC restriction is established.

records.name: Ribrianne's Eternal Love
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ137. Fires a heart-shaped projectile; current reference reports 25% damage across 14 hits at base and up to 45% when powered by Formation! and successful Pretty Cannon setup. The attack temporarily uses Ribrianne's Super Ribrianne form; exact hit-confirm/frame details remain unresolved.

records.name: Supreme Fury
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ179. The user pulls back a fist and slams it down; holding the input charges the strike while absorbing melee attacks. At full charge, the attack becomes stronger and can break the guard of attackers during the charge, enabling a follow-up Ultimate. Exact charge timing and numerical damage remain unresolved.

records.name: Surging Spirit
records.mechanics_notes: Built-in Ultra Instinct Ki-charge action rather than a separately acquired equipable skill. Current references describe it as a charge function that refills Ki in roughly five seconds and charges faster than Maximum Charge; Ultra Instinct CaCs access it through the Awoken Skill's dedicated guard+heavy input while the form is active.

validation.evidence_policy: bounded; no unsupported probabilities, frame data, hidden prerequisites, or patch-independent balance claims
